div.b:
① Create the FeatureStore object once and reuse it for every request.
② Warm up first so the registry is cached before you start timing.
③ Time only get_online_features() plus to_dict with perf_counter_ns.
④ Report p50, p95 and p99 instead of the average.
⑤ Compare against a raw Redis round trip to see the Feast overhead.
